newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Seven die in rebel attack in Philippines - army.
newsitem.headline: Seven die in rebel attack in Philippines - army.

text.p: Seven Moslem rebels died when guerrillas on Saturday attacked an army camp in renewed fighting in the southern Philippines, the military said.
Three civilians, two soldiers and a rebel, were wounded after 150 Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) guerillas attacked the camp in Pagalungan town, Maguindanao province, it said.
The army report on rebel losses could not be immediately confirmed from independent sources.
The army used jet bombers and a rocket-firing helicopter gunship to repel the attack, deputy southern military commander Brigadier-General Ronnie Benedicto told reporters.

It was the first clash between the two sides since the MILF last week cancelled cease-fire talks with a government panel after a nine-day fighting in which the military said it killed more than 70 rebels while losing seven dead.
About 1,000 residents hid in townhalls on Saturday to escape the new round of fighting, military reports said.
More than 30,000 civilians fled their villages in the previous fighting but the military said several hundred families had trickled back to their homes.
The MILF, with an estimated 8,000 armed fighters, is battling for independence for Mindanao, the ancestral Moslem homeland in the predominantly Christian country.
